title: Operating Lines of Credit Available Credit and the Largest Phone Advance
content:
The largest advance an Operating Lines of Credit line will make by phone on a given day is its available credit, held within what is left of the day's phone limit.

## Definitions

- **Lending limit**: the commitment, or the lower of the commitment and the borrowing base on the line's most recent certificate when the product requires a borrowing base.
- **Outstanding principal**: the principal worked out from the line's transaction history — advances plus returned principal payments less principal payments.
- **Available credit**: on a revolving product, the lending limit less the outstanding principal; on a product that is not revolving, the commitment less every advance booked on the line.
- **Room left on the phone limit**: the product's phone daily limit less the phone advances already booked that day.
- **Advance**: the available credit, never less than zero and never more than the room left on the phone limit, rounded to cents.

## Worked figures (hypothetical lines)

| Item | Revolving Operating Line | Revolving Operating Line, USD 50,000 already drawn by phone today | Seasonal Operating Loan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commitment | USD 500,000.00 | USD 500,000.00 | USD 400,000.00 |
| Advances; principal payments; returned principal payments | USD 600,000.00; USD 172,345.67; USD 10,000.00 | USD 600,000.00; USD 172,345.67; USD 10,000.00 | USD 350,000.00 in all; repayments do not count |
| Outstanding principal | USD 437,654.33 | USD 437,654.33 | — |
| Available credit | USD 62,345.67 | USD 62,345.67 | USD 50,000.00 |
| Phone daily limit; room left | USD 100,000.00; USD 100,000.00 | USD 100,000.00; USD 50,000.00 | USD 50,000.00; USD 50,000.00 |
| Advance | USD 62,345.67 | USD 50,000.00 — held to the room left | USD 50,000.00 |

## Points of judgement

- A line whose outstanding principal already exceeds its lending limit has a negative available credit, and the advance is zero.
- On a Borrowing Base Operating Line with a commitment of USD 3,000,000 and a borrowing base of USD 2,400,000 on its most recent certificate, the lending limit is USD 2,400,000.
